query_clauses: existing a.content / c.tdocNumber / c.reasonForChange / c.summaryOfChange only
semantic_evidence.finding: The approval verb must bind the current CR identifier in the same affirmative clause as its object (including a current CR list or a postposed adopted-object clause). Merely colocating a positive word and an unrelated CR identifier is insufficient. The repair uses only existing frozen Agreement content, REFERENCES and CR metadata fields with generic structural and approval-object grammar; no answer IDs, specific meeting/spec identifiers, external source-derived answer mapping, status filter, new collection or model calls are inserted. Actual original sources validate scope and roles rather than supply production values. Original scoring modules and fixed7 criteria are unchanged; ROOT independent review/native/seal remain separate pending gates.
